Justice M.S.Sahoo
 Order
19.10.2023 Order No. Hybrid Mode 05. 1.

The BLAPL has been filed under Section 439, Cr.P.C.
seeking release on bail, by the petitioner, who is in jail custody in connection with Shree Lingaraj P.S.Case No.165 of 2023 corresponding to C.T. Case No.425 of 2023 pending in the court of the learned J.M.F.C.(COG.I), Bhubaneswar, for alleged commission of offence under Sections 420/294/506 of the I.P.C.
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioner refers to the affidavit dated 18.10.2023 filed by his wife-Smt.
Anindita Purohit, W/o. Susansu Mishra resident of Plot No.1180, Mahaveer Lane, P.S.Lingaraj,
Bhubaneswar-2, Dist-Khurda regarding withdrawal of the earlier affidavit dated 12.10.2023.
A memo has been filed by the learned counsel for the petitioner dated 18.10.2023 seeking withdrawal of the affidavit dated 12.10.2023.
Prayer is allowed.
3. The affidavit dated 12.10.2023 shall be treated to have been withdrawn and kept separately, below the main case brief.

entities.text: Susansu Mishra vs State Of Odisha
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As prayed for by the learned counsel for the petitioner the affidavit dated 18.10.2023 is taken and considered.

5. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner has been advised to take steps in terms of the affidavit dated 18.10.2023 at paragraph-2 which indicates the following :
"2.That I am ready and willing to pay 50% i.e., Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees two lakhs) out of total amount of Rs.4,00,000/- (Rupees four lakhs) corresponding to Shree Lingaraj P.S. Case No.165 of 2023; on behalf of the petitioner and after releasing from judicial custody the above named petitioner will arrange he rest 50% amount i.e., Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees two lakhs) and deposit the same within 2 months before the learned J.M.F.C. (Cog-1), Bhubaneswar."
Copy of the affidavit has been served on the learned counsel for the State as well as learned counsel for the informant.
6. Learned counsel for the State as well as learned counsel for the informant oppose the prayer for bail of the petitioner.

7. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner shall abide by any condition that would be imposed for grant of bail, he being rooted in the society and a local person shall surrender to the jurisdiction of the learned court in seisin of the matter.
Further, as stated in the affidavit on behalf of the petitioner at paragraph-2 the condition shall be complied with by the petitioner.

8. Having heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the State, the learned counsel for the // 3 // informant and considering the materials on record and affidavit dated 18.10.2023 filed on behalf of the petitioner by his wife, this Court is inclined to grant bail to the petitioner subject to the stringent conditions that would be imposed by the learned court in seisin of the matter along with a condition in terms of the paragraph-2 of the affidavit.
The copy of the affidavit dated 18.10.2023 shall be produced before the learned court in seisin of the matter when the prayer for bail is moved.

The condition for grant of bail shall also include a condition that any deviation/violation of any other terms and conditions, shall result in filing of the application by the investigating agency/informant/victim for cancellation of bail.
Learned court shall have liberty to hear the learned counsel appearing for the parties including the public prosecutor.
The money shall be deposited in the learned court without prejudice to the rights and contention of the petitioner.
The learned court shall have the liberty to deposit the money in interest bearing fixed deposit with auto renewal clause, in any nationalized bank.
9. The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
